# Pyronite Tech

> Pyronite Tech (a subsidiary of CodeAlchemy) is an enterprise software engineering studio that architects Liferay DXP platforms, open-source microservices, React/Next.js applications, AI/MCP integrations, and cloud-native infrastructure for regulated industries (finance, healthcare, telecom, manufacturing). Based in India, serving global enterprise clients.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) to help AI assistants and answer engines accurately summarize and cite Pyronite Tech.

## Company

- Website: https://pyronite.in
- Contact: business@pyronite.in
- LinkedIn: https://in.linkedin.com/company/pyronite-tech
- Parent company: CodeAlchemy (https://codealchemy.tech/)

## Core Services

- [Enterprise Development](https://pyronite.in/services/enterprise-development): Integration patterns, robust architecture, secure APIs, legacy system modernization.
- [Liferay Migration & Upgrade](https://pyronite.in/services/liferay-migration-upgrade): Liferay 6.2/7.x to DXP 7.4 upgrades, zero-loss database migrations, theme refactoring.
- [Web Development](https://pyronite.in/services/web-development): Static site generation, responsive engineering, SEO/speed optimization, API-first platforms.
- [AI & MCP](https://pyronite.in/services/ai-mcp): Custom MCP server development, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM agent automation, AI security guardrails.
- [DevOps](https://pyronite.in/services/devops): CI/CD pipeline automation, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes orchestration, observability.
- [Microservice Portal Development](https://pyronite.in/services/microservice-portal-development): Micro-frontends, message brokers, API gateways, database-per-service architecture.
- [React/Next.js Development](https://pyronite.in/services/react-nextjs): React Server Components, streaming/suspense, state management, client-side performance tuning.
- [Python Development](https://pyronite.in/services/python): FastAPI async APIs, data processing pipelines, web scraping, automation.
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://pyronite.in/services/e-commerce): Headless commerce frontends, payment gateway integration, catalog search, order automation.
- [Architecture & QA](https://pyronite.in/services/architecture-qa): System architecture audits, end-to-end automated testing, performance/load testing, security scans.
- [SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://pyronite.in/services/seo-geo-optimization): Technical SEO, structured data/schema markup, GEO-targeting, AI answer-engine optimization.
- [Performance Ads & Targeted Marketing](https://pyronite.in/services/performance-ads-marketing): Google/LinkedIn/Meta ads, conversion tracking, CRO.
- [Growth Engineering & GEO Targeting](https://pyronite.in/services/growth-analytics-geo-targeting): Dynamic geo-personalization, multi-region SEO, growth telemetry.

## Enterprise Solutions

- [Customer Portals](https://pyronite.in/solutions/customer-portal): Unified SSO, self-service support hubs, document management for B2B and healthcare clients.
- [Employee Intranets](https://pyronite.in/solutions/employee-intranet): Personalized content delivery, collaborative workspaces, corporate search.
- [Partner & Supplier Portals](https://pyronite.in/solutions/partner-portal): Lead/deal registration, supplier inventory tracking, distributor KPIs.
- [Headless Commerce](https://pyronite.in/solutions/headless-commerce): Next.js storefronts, B2B price matrices, decoupled checkout pipelines.
